competitionInvitations.title: Competition invitations
competitionInvitations.lead: Your competition was only the beginning. Choose how you would like to stay involved. These are invitations to explore; each activity has its own sign-up and eligibility rules.
competitionInvitations.empty: There are no invitations available for your account right now.
competitionInvitations.unavailable: This invitation or opportunity is no longer available.
competitionInvitations.guardian: You received this invitation as the participant's verified guardian. A teen with their own login must join the community or apply to volunteer or start a club themselves. Your choices do not enrol them.
